name: George W. Nebinger School
notes: Options thin out after 5th grade. For grades 6–8 the pickup choices are Zhang Sah, Queen & Rook and Butcher’s Sew Shop (Fridays), plus Philly Art Center and Shot Tower through 6th. Fleisher and Mighty Writers are both within a few blocks for children old enough to walk.
The city’s free, city-funded after-school programs do not include one at Nebinger. The nearest are school-based programs at Vare-Washington for its own students.
checkedNoPickup: Christian Street YMCA (1724 Christian St), K–6. Its pickup list does not include Nebinger.
Kids on 12th (204 S 12th St), K–5. Picks up from McCall, Greenfield, ICS, FACTS, Russell Byers and Coppin only.
ZAZZ (1923 Chestnut St), ages 5–12. Guaranteed pickup from Greenfield, ICS and Marian Anderson only.
Philly Music Factory (2100 Chestnut St). Greenfield, ICS and Marian Anderson only. Its sister site MoveMakers at 812 Chestnut does list Nebinger.
Children’s Village (125 N 8th St), ages 5–13, takes CCIS subsidy. No Nebinger pickup is stated. Phone 215-931-0190.

notes: Options thin out after 5th grade. For grades 6–8 the pickup choices are Zhang Sah, Queen & Rook and Butcher’s Sew Shop (Fridays), plus Philly Art Center through 6th. Fleisher is about three blocks away for children old enough to walk.
The city’s free, city-funded after-school programs do not include one at Meredith.
checkedNoPickup: Christian Street YMCA (1724 Christian St), K–6. Its pickup list does not include Meredith.
Kids on 12th (1112 Chestnut St), K–5. Picks up from ICS, McCall, Greenfield, Russell Byers, Coppin and FACTS only.
Beehive at Bok. Its Bok pickup list is Kirkbride, Coppin, Nebinger, Southwark, Jenks and Vare-Washington.
ZAZZ (1923 Chestnut St), ages 5–12. Guaranteed pickup from Greenfield, ICS and Marian Anderson only.

name: Fanny Jackson Coppin School
notes: Coppin dismisses earlier than most programs start. Ask each provider what time they collect children.
Options thin out after 5th grade. For grades 6–8 the pickup choices are Zhang Sah, Makom Community and Butcher’s Sew Shop (Fridays), plus Philly Art Center and the two rec centers through 6th.
The city’s free, city-funded after-school programs do not include one at Coppin.
checkedNoPickup: Christian Street YMCA (1724 Christian St), K–6. It is on Coppin’s 2024 sheet, but the Y’s current pickup list does not include Coppin.
Old Pine Community Center. Picks up from McCall, Meredith, Nebinger and St. Peter’s only.
Settlement Music School. Escorts from Meredith, McCall and Nebinger only.
Queen & Rook Game Cafe. Its listed pickup schools do not include Coppin.
ZAZZ (1923 Chestnut St), ages 5–12. Guaranteed pickup from Greenfield, ICS and Marian Anderson only.

name: Vare-Washington Elementary School
notes: Vare-Washington has free before and after school care in the building, through the City’s Extended Day, Extended Year program. The City’s page says registration is closed for now, so ask the school office about openings.
Dismissal is 2:54 pm, earlier than at most schools nearby. Most outside programs start at 3:30, so ask each one when its staff collect.

For grades 6–8, Zhang Sah takes children through 8th grade and Queen & Rook through age 16. Ask the other programs about older children. Fleisher is about half a mile away for children old enough to walk.
checkedNoPickup: Philly InMovement. Its Queen Village studio picks up from Meredith, Nebinger, McCall and ICS (Wednesdays); its Bok site from Coppin, Southwark and Kirkbride.
Settlement Music School. Escorts from Meredith, Nebinger and McCall only.
Old Pine Community Center. Picks up from McCall, Meredith, Nebinger and St. Peter’s only.
Butcher’s Sew Shop Junior. Meredith, Coppin, Nebinger, McCall (Tuesdays and Thursdays) and Southwark (Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays).
MoveMakers (812 Chestnut St). McCall, Meredith and Nebinger only.
Kids on 12th (1112 Chestnut St), K–5. Picks up from ICS, McCall, Greenfield, Russell Byers, Coppin and FACTS only.
Christian Street YMCA (1724 Christian St). Serves Stanton, ICS and Marian Anderson.
Imagine That Philly. Runs inside Coppin and Nebinger only.

name: General George A. McCall School
dismissalNote: Kindergarten and bus riders at 3:30, grades 1–2 at 3:35, grades 3–5 at 3:37, grades 6–8 at 3:39, per the school’s 2023 bell schedule
notes: McCall has a free before and after school program in the building, run by Sunrise of Philadelphia. After school runs until 5:30 pm.
Ten outside programs name McCall on their own pickup lists.

Options thin out after 5th grade. Zhang Sah takes children through 8th grade, Queen & Rook through age 16, and Butcher’s Sew Shop through 15 (Tuesdays and Thursdays from McCall). Sunrise takes grades 6–8 too.
